name: StudyStudio
description: A flashcard learning plugin for Obsidian based on FSRS algorithm

scripts.dictionary:engine: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p dictionary-engine && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dictionary_engine.wasm --target web --out-dir src/features/dictionary/domain/engine --out-name dictionary_engine
scripts.build: pnpm run format && pnpm run typecheck && vp build
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.lint: pnpm run typecheck && vp lint src
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run test
